1.title: ▣ Commands
1.body:
▣ /start — Wake Kai up
▣ /help — Open this help center
▣ /ping — Check response speed
▣ /resmemory — Clear your chat memory
▣ /stats — Bot statistics (owner)

Just send a message anytime — Kai’s always listening.

2.title: ✨ Charm Battle Arena
2.body:
▣ /flirt — Reply to someone — Kai flirts with them
▣ /shayari — Reply to someone — Get some shayari
▣ /steal [amount] — Reply to someone — Try to steal from them
▣ /send [amount] — Send money to a user (reply or @username)
▣ /shield — Buy 2h protection for 200 coins
▣ /wallet — Check balance and total stolen
▣ /profile — View your profile
▣ /leaderboard — Charm Top / Richest / Chat Top / Global Chat

New users start with 500 coins. A 100-coin protection floor applies to steals.

3.title: 🎮 Party Games
3.body:
▣ /trust [amount] — Reply to someone — Prisoner’s Dilemma
▣ /bid [amount] — Bid on Kai’s active auction
▣ /flip [amount] — Flip a coin for virtual coins

Trust Game: cooperate or betray. Auctions are settled safely after the bidding window.

4.title: 🎁 Referrals & Coupons
4.body:
▣ /invite — Get your referral link + milestone progress
▣ /redeem [code] — Redeem a coupon code

Refer friends for big milestone bonuses — check /invite for details.

5.title: 📅 Daily Check-in
5.body:
▣ /checkin — Check in once a day, build your streak

Miss a day and your streak resets — come back daily!
